tests.description: The nobody-wrote-alt direction, and the check that keeps the manifest current as images are added: committing an image without describing it fails CI rather than silently shipping an undescribed photo.

tests.description: The broken-reference direction: a record whose image was deleted or renamed would render as a broken thumbnail the editor cannot fix.
